password-digest: One column: cards.db_content of a +*password card, when it holds a password digest. The port's default policy stores PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 where Ruby stores salted SHA-1 and rewrites a legacy digest at sign-in, where Ruby writes nothing (docs/SECURITY.md, Passwords). Ruby cannot produce or verify that value. Every other column, row and table is graded, including card_changes.
